newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Jones Medical started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Jones Medical started.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it initiated coverage of Jones Medical Industries Inc with a rating of outperform and a near-term price target of $40.

-- EVEREN said Jones Medical has proven its effectiveness through 16 acquisitions since its inception and through its marketing efforts. The prescription pharmaceutical company does not have a pipeline, but buys companies and product lines that have lost the attention of management, EVEREN said.
-- EVEREN's current gross margin estimate for Jones Medical is 61 percent versus 50.5 percent reported last year.
-- The current estimate for fiscal 1997 earnings is $1.40, while the estimate for fiscal 1998 is $1.35, EVEREN said.
-- Jones Medical shares were off one Thursday at 32-1/2.
